scope: Read-only historical ImageNet-A r=.25 seed2 10-task components: recovery9 + AB2 + legacy native g3. Single-task and formation experiments are excluded and handled separately.

metric_definitions.AAA_task_macro: Mean of the mean task accuracy at each of 10 stages.
metric_definitions.LA: Mean of the 10 diagonal learning accuracies.
metric_definitions.BWT: Mean final accuracy minus diagonal accuracy, over the 9 old tasks.
metric_definitions.forgetting: Mean maximum observed accuracy minus final accuracy, over the 9 old tasks.
metric_definitions.units: percentage points; per-task cells use native sample accuracy

probe_definitions.N: native gradient normalization with frozen epsilon and floating-point perturb/unperturb order

scale_definitions.natural: Exact nominal learning rate on the selected component direction.
scale_definitions.matched: Choose SGD scalar so actual joint effective change in unscaled LoRA B@A and all seen FC weight/bias matches nominal-LR projected-g1 counterfactual at candidate own state, same batch, after native unperturb. Not an independent g1 trajectory reference.
scale_definitions.native_nominal_lr: Legacy native learner, nominal learning rate, global data RNG.

projection_definitions.native_projected_g1: Native lambda_flat=1 path computes clean + 1*(g1-clean), preserving FP32 operation order; differs minutely from raw mathematical g1.
projection_definitions.B_c21_perp: c21=g2-g1; a=sum_p <g1,p,c21,p>/sum_p ||g1,p||^2 with FP64 global reductions over all trainable LoRA factors A/B and seen FC; update g1+c21-a*g1. Native GAM gamma remains zero.

mirror_deduplication.handling: Count canonical deployed raw outputs only; O-LoRA directory is staging/control mirror, not another training.
